_file_note: Notes for app/data/model/poster.json: where each field came from, who writes and reads it, and the rules it must obey. The field's type, allowed answers, required-ness and column type live with the class in app/models/. Merged by app/repositories/model_catalogue_repository.py.
about: An uploaded poster or advert, and the text brief the vision model read from it.
rules: The brief describes the poster only: words, pictures, layout, claim. Never who it suits or how it would perform.

read_at.note: Set when the brief is read; absent while brief is null.
